outline.title: 宝葫芦里的反向山谷 / The Reverse Valley in the Magic Gourd
outline.summary: 夏天和林老师在老爷爷的小院里遇到宝葫芦失控，七兄弟和老爷爷一起被吸进反向山谷，出口还被蛇精封住。山谷有一条特殊规则：每个本领都必须先帮助同伴，才会变成能点亮出口的七色印记。队伍在夏天的提醒和林老师的安排下，改掉各自硬闯的习惯，把本领变成互相配合的步骤，一枚一枚集齐印记。最后，七色印记按正确顺序放回宝葫芦口，大家带着老爷爷回到小院，蛇精的咒语也失效了。

chapters.title: 掉进反向山谷 / Falling into the Reverse Valley
chapters.summary: 宝葫芦把大家吸进反向山谷后，出口立刻缩紧，蛇精的咒语让每一次硬闯都更危险。林老师让夏天先别催着兄弟们冲，夏天带着大娃去扶起断裂的石桥，三娃在旁边挡住滚石。石桥被扶稳后，第一枚七色印记亮了起来，大家也第一次看懂了山谷的规则。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 适合用过去式描述被吸进山谷、第一次找到规则和印记亮起的经过。

chapters.title: 学会先帮人 / Learning to Help First
chapters.summary: 前方的路变成又窄又热的石缝，谁先冲都会被风吹散。二娃先找出风口和安全路，五娃再把热石上的火苗压下去，林老师让夏天把队伍分成两组跟进。大家穿过石缝时，第二和第三枚印记一起出现，通往山谷中心的路被打开了。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 可以自然练习正在发生的动作和随后发生的结果，描述找路、灭火和前进。

chapters.title: 荆棘石台 / The Thorny Stone Platform
chapters.summary: 山谷中心外围着荆棘网，老爷爷被困在高台上，直接冲进去只会把网越收越紧。六娃先隐身进去把绳子递给老爷爷，四娃再按他的指点烧开一条安全口子。老爷爷回到队伍身边，还认出石台上的刻纹，提醒大家出口需要按七枚印记的顺序排放。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 适合用过去式和进行时描述潜入、救援和正在变化的荆棘状态。

chapters.title: 宝葫芦换了用法 / A New Way to Use the Gourd
chapters.summary: 蛇精开始反向念咒，最后两枚印记被拉到葫芦边上，谁只想硬收都会被弹回来。七娃不再把宝葫芦当成抓人的工具，而是让三娃顶住反弹、大娃稳住葫芦口，自己把葫芦口对准空出的岩缝。宝葫芦没有吞掉队伍，反而把第六和第七枚印记送回大家手里，七枚印记终于集齐。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 可以自然练习正在进行的反咒、配合动作和结果变化，突出七娃改变用法。

chapters.title: 七色印记开门 / The Seven Marks Open the Door
chapters.summary: 七枚印记都到齐了，可出口还会根据“先帮谁、后用谁”的顺序重新排列，顺序错了就会再缩回去。夏天举着印记提醒顺序，林老师让七兄弟依次把自己最先帮助同伴的那一步放进出口图案里。七色光门打开后，大家带着老爷爷回到小院，蛇精的咒语也跟着散开了。
chapters.knowledgePointRecommendationSummary: 适合用一般现在时说明出口规则，也可以用将来时表达大家接下来要回到小院。

args.title: 掉进反向山谷 / Falling into the Reverse Valley
args.cleanText: The magic gourd suddenly pulled everyone into the Reverse Valley. Above them, the Snake Spirit began a spell, and the rocky exit quickly shrank. Big Brother rushed toward it, but the ground shook harder. Ms. Lin asked Summer to slow the team down. Summer noticed a broken stone bridge ahead and called Big Brother over. Big Brother lifted the heavy bridge while Summer guided its loose end into place. Rolling stones fell down the slope, so Third Brother raised his strong body and blocked them. The others crossed the steady bridge safely. A bright red mark then appeared above Big Brother's hands. Grandpa pointed at its light, and everyone understood the valley's rule: a power worked only after it helped a companion.

args.title: 学会先帮人 / Learning to Help First
args.cleanText: Beyond the bridge, the path narrowed into a hot stone crack. Strong wind threw anyone who moved alone toward the walls. Second Brother studied the dust and found the hidden air vents. He called, "The wind is blowing harder near the left wall, but the middle path is safe." Fifth Brother saw small flames dancing across the hot stones. Fifth Brother said, "I am cooling the stones now, so wait behind me." He poured water over the flames and cooled the narrow passage. Following Ms. Lin's plan, Summer divided everyone into two groups. Second Brother led the first group along the safe route, and Fifth Brother protected the second. When all of them crossed the crack, two new marks appeared together, and a stone doorway opened toward the valley's center.

args.title: 荆棘石台 / The Thorny Stone Platform
args.cleanText: At the valley's center, a tight net of thorns surrounded a high stone platform. Grandpa was trapped above it. When Big Brother stepped forward, the vines closed closer. Sixth Brother became invisible and slipped through a small opening. From inside, he called, "The thorns are tightening around Grandpa, so nobody should push the net." Then he threw a rope up to Grandpa. Sixth Brother guided Grandpa toward the safe side and showed Fourth Brother where to aim. Fourth Brother said, "I am burning only the empty gap." After checking everyone's position, he burned a narrow opening through the thorns. Sixth Brother lowered Grandpa safely, and another two marks shone. Grandpa then recognized carved lines on the stone platform. The ancient pattern showed that all seven marks had to enter the exit in the order of the brothers' helpful acts.

args.title: 宝葫芦换了用法 / A New Way to Use the Gourd
args.cleanText: Near the exit, the Snake Spirit chanted her spell backward. The last two marks flew toward the magic gourd, and anyone who grabbed them was thrown back. Seventh Brother raised the gourd, but he did not use it to capture anyone. He shouted, "The spell is pulling the marks toward us. We need to turn its force into help!" Third Brother stood in front of him. Third Brother blocked the returning force while Big Brother held the mouth of the gourd steady. Seventh Brother said, "I am pointing the gourd toward that open crack now." He carefully turned it away from the team. Instead of swallowing his companions, the gourd sent the two marks through the opening and into their hands. The sixth and seventh marks glowed beside the others, and the team finally held the complete seven-color set.

args.title: 七色印记开门 / The Seven Marks Open the Door
args.cleanText: The team carried all seven marks to the shrinking exit, but its colors kept changing places. Grandpa showed Summer the carved pattern. Summer lifted the marks and said, "The door follows each helpful act, not each brother's usual place." Ms. Lin added, "If everyone follows that order, the pattern will become complete." Summer said, "We gather here to remember whom each brother helped first." Ms. Lin said, "The seven brothers will place their marks one by one." Summer checked each step and said, "The colors match now. We will return home together, and everyone will guide Grandpa through the gate." The last mark clicked into the exit, opening a seven-colored gate. They returned safely to the courtyard. Behind them, the Snake Spirit's spell broke apart, and the magic gourd became quiet.
